why: A binding onto another action's button must be returned to the profile's own button; detecting no clash lets it stand, putting two actions on one button, and Fire on Confirm's button is the #494 leak. Cut at clash DETECTION rather than at the re-check loop: skipping only the re-check still removes the one clashing binding and returns the untouched profile, which the single-binding test cannot tell apart.
killedBy: resolveEffectiveProfile (issue #754) refuses a binding onto another action's button, so Confirm can never also fire (#494)
resolveEffectiveProfile (issue #754) never leaves two of the nine actions on one button, over every single and paired binding
